ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

2. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sanitation/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sanitation/ PRACTICES.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying : OUR SCHOOL? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on : OUR SCHOOL.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for : OUR SCHOOL.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about : OUR SCHOOL.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to : OUR SCHOOL.

6. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Paper burning to ash

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Producers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

9. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hand washing PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hand washing PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Hand washing PRACTICES.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hand washing PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hand washing PRACTICES.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for the teeth PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for the teeth PRACTICES.

12. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Myself ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain : OUR SCHOOL and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Home ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

4. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sanitation/ PRACTICES.

5. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for : OUR SCHOOL.

6. A — Ice melting to water

8. B — Producers

9. B — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

10. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hand washing PRACTICES.

11. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for the teeth PRACTICES.

12. D — newton (N)
